research_question: Within smooth incompressible inviscid vortex dynamics, can a fixed material population carrying nonzero vorticity coexist with an exterior locally irrotational sector that still carries nonzero velocity, circulation periods, kinetic energy, and a reproducible far field, while the original A016 relaxed-centerline relative-equilibrium test remains independently falsifiable?, and are those geometry-dependent classifications robust across distinct E011 STATIC_READY upstream provider groups for the same topology?
objective: Fuse the v0.1.1 Helmholtz centerline gates with theorem-level Cauchy-map controls and explicit matter-field-partition observables, without retuning the original H0-H4 thresholds and without allowing an early scientific FAIL to suppress later independent measurements. v0.2.2 consumes the real E011-v0.3.0 STATIC_READY falsifier-facing atlas derived from E010-v0.3.1 and tests whether the matter-field classifications are provider dependent.
null_hypothesis: At least one registered ideal-flow consequence or centerline condition fails beyond its preregistered tolerance, or the resulting H2/H3/P3/P4/P5/P6 classifications are not reproducible across the required distinct upstream E011 provider groups for the same topology. Material zero/nonzero vorticity classification, material volume, vorticity flux, exterior potentiality, exterior energy support, far-field scaling, relaxed-centerline relative equilibrium, and cross-source provider consistency are therefore independently falsifiable.
alternative_hypothesis: The exact material controls satisfy Cauchy/volume/flux invariance; the reconstructed exterior is locally divergence-free and curl-free but nontrivial; a resolved nonzero kinetic-energy fraction lies outside the near-core source zone; eligible closed filaments show stable localized-source far-field scaling; each admitted E011 STATIC_READY carrier receives an independent H0-H4/P3-P6 classification without threshold adjustment; and, for topologies with at least two distinct upstream E011 provider groups, the preregistered X0 agreement criterion is satisfied.
assumptions: The continuum comparison is the smooth three-dimensional incompressible Euler limit with no viscosity and no external nonconservative forcing.

Each input component is interpreted as a closed oriented vortex-filament centerline; finite-core regularization is a numerical model for self-interaction, not a claim that vorticity is literally singular.
Blind centerline scoring uses source coordinate units and unit circulation; no SST particle identity, canonical circulation, density, mass, or clock parameter enters H0-H4 or P3-P6.
The exterior differential audit uses the singular filament kernel only at points separated from the source, where the ideal line-vortex field should be locally curl-free and divergence-free.
The P5 source-zone mask is a preregistered geometric near-core proxy; it tests energy nonlocality of the reconstructed velocity field, not an exact compact-support vorticity inversion.
The P6 r^{-p} fit is evaluated only for geometries with non-negligible vector area, so cancellation of the leading far-field moment is not mislabeled as a numerical failure.

E011-v0.3.0 is used as the falsifier-facing STATIC_READY geometry/provenance layer derived from E010-v0.3.1. E010 full_campaign_gate_pass/publication_ready_geometry_layer may be false globally; this does not invalidate the explicit E011 admitted subset. STATIC_READY does not establish Euler/Biot-Savart stability or DYNAMICS_READY.

equations.purpose: Cauchy vorticity map for incompressible Euler
equations.dimensional_check: F is dimensionless and both vorticities have T^-1.
determinant of a dimensionless deformation gradient is dimensionless.
T^-1 times L^2 equals L^2 T^-1.

equations.purpose: Unit-circulation Biot-Savart reconstruction outside and on regularized filament fields
equations.dimensional_check: Gamma L times L divided by L^3 gives L T^-1.
ell_E has L; rho Gamma^2 ell_E gives (M L^-3)(L^4 T^-2)L=M L^2 T^-2.
each term has velocity dimensions L T^-1; lambda has L T^-1.

equations.dimensional_check: line integral has L^2 T^-1 and division by Gamma is dimensionless.
both divergence and curl of velocity have T^-1.
identical energy-density-volume factors cancel, leaving a dimensionless fraction.
the slope of logarithms of consistently scaled quantities is dimensionless.

equations.dimensional_check: This equation maps only exponents; dimensional pressure normalization is not inferred by the blind fit.

observables.definition: Cauchy-map relative error and zero/nonzero population classification
finite-core energy convergence and relative-equilibrium normal NRMSE
dimensionless exterior divergence and curl residuals
exterior kinetic-energy fraction and refinement drift
far-field velocity exponent p, fit R^2, and derived post-reveal pressure exponents
provider-collapsed E011 cross-source classification agreement and informational within-topology dispersion

steps.operation: Verify the frozen protocol and resolve the pinned E011-v0.3.0 STATIC_READY output bundle from source_contract.json plus SST_WORKBENCH_ROOT; verify its E010-v0.3.1 parent and exact raw-source provenance.
Run self-contained Python FP64 circle sanity controls before external source scoring.
Evaluate the exact diagonal incompressible Cauchy map for zero/nonzero vorticity populations.
Evaluate det(F) and the analytic material cross-section scaling.
Evaluate initial/final vorticity flux under the same exact stretch.
Resample each closed source geometry, estimate finite-core thickness, and calculate original A016 H0-H4 observables at preregistered resolutions.
Sample an exterior sphere and use centered finite differences of singular-kernel Biot-Savart velocity to estimate divergence and curl.
Reuse meridian circulation periods together with nonzero exterior speed to test locally irrotational but globally nontrivial exterior flow.
Integrate the finite-core velocity-energy proxy with deterministic Halton-ball samples at two sample counts and partition by the preregistered near-core mask.
Fit log RMS speed versus log radius on preregistered far-field shells for nonzero-vector-area closed sources.
Build the instance-local C++17/OpenMP kernel and compare its FP64 Biot-Savart output against the Python FP64 reference with no fallback authority.

Group blind E011 samples by opaque topology and upstream provider group. FULL uses deterministic provider anchors; CERTIFY collapses same-provider primary-carrier variants to one vote and marks disagreements INTERNAL_INCONSISTENCY. Evaluate H2/H3/P3/P4/P5/P6 state agreement.

falsification_criteria.criterion: P0 fails if Cauchy-map relative error exceeds 1e-12 or a zero/nonzero population changes class in the exact control.
P1 fails if |det(F)-1| exceeds 1e-12; P2 fails if relative vorticity-flux drift exceeds 1e-12.
H3 fails per input when normal relative-equilibrium NRMSE exceeds 0.18; this threshold is inherited unchanged from v0.1.1.
P3 fails per input if the exterior differential residuals exceed 0.08 or fewer than eight exterior points are valid.
P5 fails per input if the refined exterior energy fraction is below 0.01 or its low/high deterministic-sampling drift exceeds 0.12.
P6 fails on an eligible input if R^2 is below 0.97 or the fitted velocity exponent lies outside [2.4,3.6]. Ineligible near-zero-vector-area inputs are not forced into this gate.
B0 fails if strict native FP64 is unavailable or C++/Python relative L2 error exceeds 1e-10; this is a certification failure, not physical evidence.

X0 is unresolved unless at least one topology has at least two distinct upstream provider groups. For each eligible topology and each registered gate H2/H3/P3/P4/P5/P6, provider-state agreement must be at least 0.80; any within-provider carrier disagreement is INTERNAL_INCONSISTENCY. Any eligible comparison below threshold falsifies X0. Generated/derived PKLSA carriers never count toward closure.

edge_cases: Near-zero vector area can remove the leading far-field moment; such inputs are P6-ineligible rather than automatically failed.
A singular filament has divergent core energy; H1/P5 therefore use the preregistered finite-core regularization while P3 exterior derivatives use the singular kernel away from support.
A source path or compiler failure is recorded independently and must not be interpreted as evidence for or against the fluid hypothesis.
Topological reconnection, viscosity, compressibility, external forcing, and singular Euler breakdown lie outside the domain of this version.

Multiple E011 primary carriers from one provider/source route are correlated. FULL uses one deterministic E011 provider anchor per topology/provider; CERTIFY admits all E011 primary STATIC_READY carriers and same-provider classification disagreement is INTERNAL_INCONSISTENCY rather than independent replication.
predictions: For the exact incompressible stretch, a fluid element with initial zero vorticity remains zero and a nonzero element remains nonzero while magnitude may change by stretching.
A locally curl-free exterior can retain nonzero velocity and nonzero circulation around noncontractible loops linked with vortex support.
Finite-core kinetic energy is not expected to be confined entirely to the near-core geometric source zone.

Closed localized vortex sources with a nonzero leading vector-area moment should approach a velocity decay exponent near three; the corresponding steady Bernoulli pressure-gradient exponent is derived only after the velocity fit is frozen.

If a Helmholtz/matter-field classification is representation-robust rather than an artifact of one embedding pipeline, distinct upstream E011 provider groups assigned to the same topology should agree on H2/H3/P3/P4/P5/P6 states at the frozen threshold.
